Container.Name: cgw-studio
Container.Overview: CGW Content Studio: upload members' photos and videos, draft posts with Claude Code over MCP (LAN only), approve every post, then publish or schedule them on batch day. Put it behind your reverse proxy with auth; block /mcp and /api/ext at the proxy and let /m/ and /u/ through without sign-in.
Container.Requires: A reverse proxy with authentication (Authelia, Authentik or similar) that sends the signed-in user in a header.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Your reverse proxy and Claude Code (MCP, LAN only) connect here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and generated secret key.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Original uploads and previews. Put it on the array if you have a lot of video.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address people use through your reverse proxy. Used in reminder emails.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: First admin account. Created on first start only, when there are no users yet.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: At least 10 characters. Change it under Settings after the first sign-in.

Config.Name: Admin email
Config.Description: Where reminder emails go (unless Reminder emails is set).

Config.Name: Require proxy auth
Config.Description: true: only accept web sign-ins that come through the trusted proxy with a user header. Set false only for a first test on the LAN.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy IP
Config.Description: Your reverse proxy's IP as seen by this container, e.g. 192.168.1.10/32 (or the Docker network address if the proxy runs on this server). The user header is trusted only from here.

Config.Name: Proxy user header
Config.Description: Header your proxy puts the signed-in username in.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: true when served over HTTPS through the proxy. Set false for a plain-HTTP LAN test.

Config.Name: MCP allowed networks
Config.Description: Claude Code connections are accepted only from these networks, and never through the proxy.

Config.Name: Mail backend
Config.Description: smtp to send reminders; console to only log them.

Config.Name: SMTP username
Config.Description: SMTP2GO SMTP user.

Config.Name: From address
Config.Description: Must be a verified sender in SMTP2GO.

Config.Name: Reminder emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated. Empty: every approver and admin with an email address.

Config.Name: Bluesky handle
Config.Description: e.g. columbiagadgetworks.bsky.social

Config.Name: Bluesky app password
Config.Description: Bluesky: Settings, Privacy and security, App passwords.

Config.Name: Batch day anchor
Config.Description: Batch days run every 14 days from this date.

Config.Name: Calendar ICS
Config.Description: Events feed.

Config.Name: LAN address
Config.Description: How computers on your network reach the Studio directly, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8095 (server IP + the Web UI port above). Settings uses it in the Claude Code and extension setup.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Photos and videos posted in the Discord uploads channel come into the media library. See docs/setup-platforms.md, Discord uploads.

Config.Name: Discord channel ID(s)
Config.Description: The uploads channel's ID (Discord: Developer Mode on, right-click the channel, Copy Channel ID). Several: separate with commas.

Config.Name: Public media address
Config.Description: Address Meta uses to fetch approved photos/videos at /m/... Must be reachable from the internet without proxy sign-in for that path. Empty: same as Public address.

Config.Name: Facebook page ID
Config.Description: See docs/setup-platforms.md in the repo.

Config.Name: Facebook page token
Config.Description: Long-lived page access token; also used for Instagram.

Config.Name: Instagram user ID
Config.Description: The Instagram business account ID linked to the page.

Config.Name: Threads token
Config.Description: Long-lived Threads token. The Studio refreshes it and keeps the new one in its database.

Config.Name: GitHub token (website)
Config.Description: Fine-grained token for ColumbiaGadgetWorks/website only, Contents read and write. Lets approved news posts publish to the site.

Config.Name: Weekly event post lead (days)
Config.Description: Weekly events like Open Hack Night get one post a week, created this many days ahead so it can use the latest photos.

Config.Name: Photo reminder in digest
Config.Description: true: the weekly digest reminds you to grab photos at this week's Open Hack Night (and other weekly events).

Config.Name: Digest day
Config.Description: Day of the one weekly reminder email (sent at the reminder hour, only if something needs you).

Config.Name: Last-call alerts
Config.Description: true: email when an unapproved post goes out within 48 hours (at most one every 3 days).

Config.Name: Event skip words
Config.Description: No promo posts for events whose titles contain these.

Config.Name: Dolibarr address
Config.Description: For the monthly email list (contacts tagged Email updates). No trailing slash.

Config.Name: Dolibarr API key
Config.Description: API key of a Dolibarr user with contacts, tags and agenda permissions.

Config.Name: Dolibarr user ID
Config.Description: Owner of the 'email sent' agenda events.

Config.Name: Email from
Config.Description: Must be a verified sender in SMTP2GO.

Config.Name: Whisper model
Config.Description: Speech model for subtitles, downloaded once to /data/models (~150 MB). Empty turns subtitles off.
